title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition (ResNet)
summary: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren and Jian Sun submitted Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition on December 10, 2015. The paper presents a residual learning framework that reformulates layers as learning residual functions with reference to layer inputs and reports experiments with residual networks up to 152 layers on ImageNet.
significance: A documented deep-learning research milestone for the residual-learning framework later published at CVPR 2016, recorded here at the paper-submission level rather than as an invention or system-birth date.

verification.note: Title, authors, December 10 2015 submission date, residual-learning formulation and reported 152-layer ImageNet experiments are supported by the original arXiv record. The Computer Vision Foundation's CVPR 2016 record independently corroborates the authors, paper, framework and later conference publication. Microsoft Research additionally records the same paper and authors as a CVPR publication in June 2016. The day-precision date is attached specifically to the arXiv submission milestone, not asserted as an invention, architecture-birth, development-start, or software-release date. No universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, institutional affiliation or geography is inferred.
